research_object: Dynamic State Probability Engine / Loss Forensics — prospective live early-warning transport

historical_actual_availability.meaning: Historical h=1 recognition latency relative to true TDCC publication availability is not validated. The prior median-3-sessions result must not be interpreted as true market-known latency.

fugle_live_transport.stale_interpretation: Expected because verification was run on Sunday 2026-11-01; stale was correctly flagged rather than treated as live Sunday trading data.
fugle_live_transport.rate_limit_design: 1.10s nominal call spacing; target <=60 calls/min on Fugle Basic plan

full_market_fugle.reason: Current100 single-symbol transport already covers the active bounded research universe. Full-market realtime expansion is not currently justified by evidence.

do_now: Use current100 Fugle live quote transport as a prospective shadow evidence source.
Preserve actual observation timestamps and source last-updated/trade timestamps.
Collect source-side live evidence for price response, trade activity, bid/ask-side volume and order-book context where available.
Measure future false negatives, false positives, repair outcomes and control-deterioration outcomes prospectively.
Keep HISTORICAL_LATENCY=DATA_BLOCKED and PROSPECTIVE_LIVE_LATENCY=COLLECTING as separate states.
do_not_do_now: Do not expand Fugle realtime coverage to all Taiwan stocks merely because the endpoint can be queried one symbol at a time.
Do not purchase the Developer plan solely to regain whole-market snapshot access.
Do not alter frozen Pass 4 coefficients, thresholds, labels or gates using live outcomes.
Do not convert the live layer directly into BUY/SELL or exact-price prediction.
Do not claim historical actual-publication latency is validated because live transport is now working.
priority_decision.expansion_trigger: Only reconsider broader Fugle market coverage if prospective current100 errors show that missing cross-sector/capital-destination context is a material and repeated source of false negatives or false positives.

prospective_live_state.target: Earlier recognition of control deterioration without excessive false alarms, using only information truly available at observation time.

governance.primary_user_goal: Reduce the chance of becoming the last liquidity provider/holder when stronger capital is already withdrawing or transferring risk; capital preservation matters more than exact-price prediction.
